definition: what fraction of me a model of the median person gets right, by axis

settled:
Viewing others as monolithic is a simplification itself, but useful here.

My first reach was that if I compared my mean to the human mean I would put the correspondence closer to ten percent, though my wife would still argue higher.

Twenty percent conceptual correspondence, eighty percent physical. Emotion is typically a bridge between the two and the conceptual side of the bridge is open, so maybe split the difference at fifty percent emotional.

My experience is eighty percent conceptual and twenty percent physical and emotional, so the weighted average comes out near a third, the two terms equal because I live most where I match least.

I think the balance is that I live mostly in my conceptual experience, and the right number for that is in the middle at twenty percent. I hold it provisionally. The ten was potentially an overcorrection.

So same thing or different thing is not one answer. Same thing on the body. A different thing in the cognition.

title: How Far The Human Prior Predicts Me
